_why: Draws one panel at a time and checks each (size, repetition, ink density), retrying with feedback, then one improve pass. Cool temperature keeps the grid intact. ASCII art quality varies hugely between models: put this agent on a strong one. Reasoning models think inside max_tokens, so thinking is capped (thinking_budget) to leave room for the drawing.
_help: Committed. Provider and model are usually set in the UI (⚙ Model). null = the .env default. API keys never go here: they're saved per provider in secrets/keys.json.
